form_title: FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5-2 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the General Election
reports.notes: Loose cursive handwriting throughout; every figure appears twice on the page (Col A/Col B, then again on lines 4-6) and the two writings agree, which is why the amounts hold at medium rather than low. Line 3 is a handwritten bare 0. The signature date is written '10/27/18'. The cover page uses the older 'FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' title (no school-board wording), while the summary sheet's header reads '2016 County & Local School Board Candidates' - a mixed-vintage packet. The summary sheet's Page/Last Name/Date of Report boxes were left blank by the filer. No amendment box marked Yes; the No circle is struck.
